title: Rationale for Legislating and Making High-rise Littering an Offence Despite Inherent Difficulty in Enforcement
what_it_is: Rationale for Legislating and Making High-rise Littering an Offence Despite Inherent Difficulty in Enforcement

sections.label: High-rise littering offence rationale
sections.summary: Minister was asked the rationale for making high-rise littering an offence despite enforcement difficulty; no separate legislative provision exists for it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment what is the rationale for legislating and making high-rise littering an offence despite the inherent difficulty in enforcement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: This covers littering in a range of scenarios, including high-rise littering.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: There is no separate legislative provision for high-rise littering.

sections.label: Second-hand smoke enforcement challenges
sections.summary: Minister says enforcement against second-hand smoke in homes is more challenging than high-rise littering, citing thermal cameras, limited range and intrusiveness.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But having said that, this question about second-hand smoke, I think the Member has asked similar questions a number of times in this House and I have given replies as to the reason why there are technological limitations in enforcement against second-hand smoke in homes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I think enforcement of second-hand smoke in homes is really distinctively more challenging than high-rise littering.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, at the risk of sounding like a broken record, let me just briefly highlight some key points that I have actually shared in my previous replies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: It is not a question of just catching an image of the physical object but also capturing the heat signature as proof of the smoking act.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, you need not just require optical cameras but also thermal surveillance cameras and there is a limited surveillance range of such surveillance cameras.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And you need to put them off the ground, which means, it would be highly intrusive because it does not only train into the suspected unit, but also other units.

sections.label: Mediation and second-hand smoke proposals
sections.summary: An inter-agency committee is reviewing the community mediation framework, and MND, MSO and HDB issued a joint call for proposals on second-hand smoke.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In addition, as Members have heard from the Second Minister for Law that there is an inter-agency, inter-Ministry Committee that is looking at revising or enhancing the community mediation framework to increase accessibility for such disputes to be resolved amicably as far as possible.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And then, last year, MND, together with Municiple Social office (MSO) and HDB, has issued a joint call for proposals on tackling second-hand smoke from neighbouring homes.
